semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in advanced 3D packaging technologies, particularly TGV (Through Glass Via) technology, which is critical for modern semiconductor integration.
summary: 3D Chips (Guangdong) Technology Co., Ltd. is a leader in TGV technology in China, focusing on the development and manufacturing of glass-based 3D packaging substrates and integration solutions. The company aims to advance post-Moore's Law integrated circuits through innovative packaging techniques and has established significant production capabilities in both wafer-level and board-level TGV.

regional_presence.China: The company has established production bases in Dongguan and Chengdu, focusing on advanced packaging technologies.
